overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Utility Committee was scheduled to convene on September 1, 2026, to address utility infrastructure and operational matters including a water tower lease renewal, septic tank review, and a data center ordinance. The meeting was set to include reports from the Director of Public Works and Utilities and financial updates.

agenda.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on an AT&T water tower lease. This item was listed under old business, indicating ongoing or renewal considerations related to the utility infrastructure agreement.
The committee was set to review septic tank matters as new business. The agenda indicates discussion and possible action were expected on this utility system component.

The committee was scheduled to consider a data center ordinance as new business. This item was set for discussion and possible action regarding regulatory framework for data center operations in the village.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, scheduled for up to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time limit per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion. Written comments could be submitted to kcoyle@kronenwetter.gov.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on or take action regarding AT&T Water Tower Lease
Expected to consider action on Septic Tank Review
Set to vote on or take action regarding Data Center Ordinance
title: Utility Committee Meeting - 2026-09-01
